question: taxi zones intersecting bbox -74.05 40.55 -73.80 40.90
sql: SELECT location_id, zone, borough FROM nyc_taxi_zones WHERE geometry && ST_MakeEnvelope(-74.05, 40.55, -73.80, 40.90) ORDER BY zone, location_id

question: envelope of staten island zones as geojson
sql: SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Envelope(ST_Union_Agg(geometry))) AS envelope_geojson FROM nyc_taxi_zones WHERE borough = 'Staten Island'

question: trips picked up inside bbox -73.89 40.73 -73.84 40.77
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pickup_trips FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones z ON t.PULocationID = z.location_id WHERE z.geometry && ST_MakeEnvelope(-73.89, 40.73, -73.84, 40.77)

question: zones fully within bbox -74.30 40.48 -74.12 40.60
sql: SELECT zone, borough FROM nyc_taxi_zones WHERE ST_Within(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-74.30, 40.48, -74.12, 40.60)) ORDER BY zone

question: zones with bbox wider than 0.05 degrees
sql: SELECT zone, borough, ST_XMax(geometry) - ST_XMin(geometry) AS bbox_width_deg FROM nyc_taxi_zones WHERE ST_XMax(geometry) - ST_XMin(geometry) > 0.05 ORDER BY bbox_width_deg DESC, zone

question: extent box per borough
sql: SELECT borough, ST_Extent_Agg(geometry) AS extent_box FROM nyc_taxi_zones GROUP BY borough ORDER BY borough
